key_point: Rockstar simulated horses down to their testicles, and players grow attached
title: In Red Dead Redemption 2, horse testicles shrink in cold weather.
caption: In Red Dead Redemption 2, horse testicles shrink in cold weather. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #reddeadredemption2 #rdr2 #rockstargames

instagram.caption:
In Red Dead Redemption 2, horse testicles shrink in cold weather and return to normal when it warms up.

It's one of hundreds of horse details. They get dirty, leave droppings, and bond with you the more you ride, feed and brush them.

That's also why it hurts so much to lose one. If your horse dies and you can't revive it, it's gone for good.

key_point: Gordon Freeman never speaks, so the player becomes him
title: In over 25 years of Half-Life, Gordon Freeman has never said a single word.
caption: In over 25 years of Half-Life, Gordon Freeman has never said a single word. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #halflife #valve #gordonfreeman

instagram.caption:
Gordon Freeman has never said a single word in any Half-Life game.

Valve kept him silent on purpose, and cut the cutscenes too. The whole story plays out through his eyes, so the player becomes Gordon.

The other characters talk to him constantly, and even joke about it. In Half-Life 2, Alyx says: "Man of few words, aren't you?"

Should Gordon ever speak?

key_point: a boss that breaks the fourth wall by reading your memory card and moving your controller
title: In Metal Gear Solid, Psycho Mantis reads your memory card and names the Konami games you'v
caption: In Metal Gear Solid, Psycho Mantis reads your memory card and names the Konami games you've played. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #metalgearsolid #psychomantis #kojima

instagram.caption:
In Metal Gear Solid (1998), Psycho Mantis reads your PlayStation memory card and comments on the other Konami games you've saved.

He then asks you to put your controller on the floor and makes it move with his "psychic power", using the rumble.

He dodges every attack because he reads your inputs. The fix: plug your controller into port 2.

Did you figure it out on your own back then?

key_point: a stranger's small kindness on a snowy hill became Dark Souls' online system
title: Dark Souls' online messages were inspired by strangers pushing cars up a snowy hill.
caption: Dark Souls' online messages were inspired by strangers pushing cars up a snowy hill. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #darksouls #fromsoftware #soulslike

instagram.caption:
Dark Souls director Hidetaka Miyazaki once got stuck on a snowy hill. Strangers got out and pushed the cars up, one by one, then drove away before anyone could thank them.

He never met them again, but he never forgot it.

That's where Dark Souls' online system came from: messages, bloodstains and summon signs left by players you'll never meet, helping you anyway.

What's the best message you ever found?

key_point: one man gave up years of his life to make it alone, and still refuses to charge for updates
title: While making Stardew Valley alone, Eric Barone worked part-time as a theater usher just to
caption: While making Stardew Valley alone, Eric Barone worked part-time as a theater usher just to get by. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #stardewvalley #indiegames #concernedape

instagram.caption:
While making Stardew Valley alone, Eric Barone worked part-time as a theater usher just to get by.

For over four years his girlfriend Amber paid most of the bills, while he did the code, art, music and writing himself.

Stardew Valley came out in 2016 and has now sold over 40 million copies. Barone has promised he will never charge for a DLC or update, as long as he lives. Every major update so far has been free.

Did you know this story?

key_point: an ignored game from a tiny team became a global hit, and they chose the original over a sequel
title: Among Us came out in 2018 and almost nobody played it. Its team of three nearly moved on.
caption: Among Us came out in 2018 and almost nobody played it. Its team of three nearly moved on. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #amongus #innersloth #indiegames

instagram.caption:
Among Us launched in 2018 to almost no players. Innersloth, a team of three, nearly moved on.

In 2020 streamers found it, and within months it reached around half a billion monthly players.

Innersloth had already announced a sequel. They cancelled it so everyone who already owned the game would get the new content.

key_point: the author sold the rights for pocket money, the games became a giant, and he wanted more
title: The Witcher's author sold the game rights for about $9,500 and turned down a share of the
caption: The Witcher's author sold the game rights for about $9,500 and turned down a share of the profits. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #thewitcher #witcher3 #cdprojektred

instagram.caption:
Andrzej Sapkowski, the author of The Witcher books, sold the video game rights for about $9,500. He was offered a share of the profits and said no.

He didn't believe games would go anywhere. The Witcher games have since sold over 75 million copies.

In 2018 he asked CD Projekt for roughly $16 million more. The two sides settled in 2019.

Would you have taken the cash or the percentage?
